content:
mike.s: Heads up — partner HW connector started returning 429s during nightly windows. Seeing ~8% of usage events drop from ingestion window.
sarah-pm: which partner/region? any customer impact flagged?
mike.s: ACME Edgebox fleet in eu-west1, connector v1.3.2. Ingest shows `rate_limit_exceeded` and connection closes. No direct customer alerts yet but ledgers show negative deltas in the daily rollups.
ingest-bot: alert: partner-ingest pipeline (acme-edgebox) — error rate spike 429s at 02:13-02:27 UTC, estimated 7.9% event loss. link: https://internal.monitoring/acme-ingest
emily-partners: ugh — that explains some reconciliation noise. Our partnership team is getting billing questions from one SI.
raj-eng: quick ideas: 1) honor `Retry-After` and exponential backoff on connector, 2) add idempotency-key header using usage_id, 3) push failed batches to DLQ for replay.
mike.s: agree. current connector retries are naive (immediate retries x3). Also missing idempotency header, so replay causes duplicates.
sarah-pm: timeline? can we hotfix today for Retry-After handling and backoff window?
raj-eng: I can cut a patch for connector today to parse 429 `Retry-After` and switch to jittered backoff. Will add `Idempotency-Key: <usage_id>` header in the next PR.
emily-partners: for reconciliation side, recommend adding a 24h reconciliation pass that: de-duplicates by idempotency key, and flags any negative deltas > $50 for manual review. I'll prep a runbook.
mike.s: technical note — some partners send batched events without stable usage_id per record. We need a mapping layer in the connector to synthesize stable keys (sha256 of partner_id + timestamp + seq) before sending to ledger.
raj-eng: ok I'll add a small deterministic keygen fallback. Will note it in the PR.
emily-partners: do we need a rollback plan if replay introduces duplicates?
mike.s: yes — ledger supports idempotent apply if idempotency-key present. For older events without keys, the reconciliation script will attempt fuzzy match and create reversal entries if necessary.
sarah-pm: ops ask: can we throttle nightly jobs to reduce burst? maybe shift partner replay to off-peak windows?
raj-eng: we can add adaptive windowing: if partner returns 429s > threshold, reduce batch concurrency from 16 -> 4 and increase interval. Quick config toggle.
emily-partners: assign ownership: @raj-eng patch connector; @mike.s follow up on ledger replays; @emily-partners create runbook and notify SI; @sarah-pm coordinate partner comms.
mike.s: I'll own the ledger replay script. Target: runbook + hotfix + DLQ wiring by EOD tomorrow.
raj-eng: starting a branch now: `fix/acme-429-backoff` — will request review from @mike.s when ready.
emily-partners: I'll draft a short partner note: "We observed transient ingestion throttling; we're patching connector to retry politely and will run a reconciliation pass. Expect follow-up by tomorrow."
sarah-pm: thanks all. small follow-ups: 1) add test that simulates 429 + Retry-After, 2) add metrics for DLQ depth, 3) add alert if replay error rate > 2%.
raj-eng: noted — adding tests and metrics.
ingest-bot: deploybot: deployment queued for branch fix/acme-429-backoff to staging at 2069993499
mike.s: 👍 I'll start vetting the replay on a small sample set once staging looks good.
emily-partners: thanks — will update SI and log this in partner-status doc. :thumbsup:
